meta.description: Procurement_Implementation_Plan.md §6, bullet 2: extends the existing invoice-OCR workflow by adding an httpRequest node after 'Parse Final Invoice JSON', alongside (not instead of) the existing Telegram reply, so the human still sees the OCR result in chat AND it lands in the review queue at POST /vendor-invoices/ingest.

nodes.name: OCR Parse Invoice (Mistral)
nodes.notes: Pre-existing node from before this phase - Mistral OCR document-understanding call against the downloaded Telegram file. Left as-is; only the downstream branch changed.

nodes.name: Parse Final Invoice JSON
nodes.notes: Pre-existing node - turns the OCR's raw text/markdown into the structured shape VendorInvoiceIngest expects. Left as-is.

nodes.name: POST /vendor-invoices/ingest
nodes.notes: NEW node added this phase. Runs in parallel with the existing Telegram reply below - the human still sees the OCR result in chat, and it also lands in PENDING_MATCH for review.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { supplier_id: $json.supplier_id, po_id: $json.po_id, grn_id: $json.grn_id ?? null, vendor_invoice_no: $json.vendor_invoice_no, invoice_date: $json.invoice_date, source: "OCR_BOT", source_confidence: $json.source_confidence ?? 0.8, raw_document_url: $json.raw_document_url ?? null, items: $json.items } }}

nodes.name: Reply in Telegram (unchanged)
nodes.notes: Pre-existing node - unchanged. The person still gets the same OCR-read confirmation they always did.

parameters.text: =Got it – read invoice {{ $json.vendor_invoice_no || '(no number found)' }} for ₹{{ $json.items ? $json.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.amount||i.quantity*i.rate),0) : '?' }}. It's now in the review queue – a purchase officer will confirm the line items before it's matched.
Please send the invoice as a photo or PDF document.
